newsitem.title: USA: Court denies blocking creation of Highmark Inc.
newsitem.headline: Court denies blocking creation of Highmark Inc.

text.p: The Commonwealth Court of Pennsylvania has denied requests to prevent Pennsylvania Blue Shield and Blue Cross of Western Pennsylvania from consolidating to become one firm called Highmark Inc, Highmark said Tuesday.

Highmark said Judge Bonnie Leadbetter denied the requests on March 27 after they were made by the Philadelphia County Medical Society, the Pennsylvania Society of Internal Medicine and two doctors, who sought an injunction to block the consolidation.
Highmark said the denial of the request means the physicians and their societies are unlikely to prevail in their lawsuit.

"Highmark has consistently maintained that the physicians' case has no merit. We welcome the ruling of the Commonwealth Court and look forward to a prompt and favorable resolution of the remaining issues," the company said in a release.
